title: Preparation of Zebrafish Whole Heart Cell Suspension for Single-Cell Analyses
author: Abu Nahia, Winata
materials: Low cell viability and/or mechanical damage to cells.
Excessive debris present in cell suspension.

steps.title: Anesthetize embryos
steps.instruction: Treat embryos with Tricaine (0.16 mg/mL in egg water) and incubate on ice for 5 min.

steps.title: De‑chorionate embryos
steps.instruction: Prepare 1 mg/mL Pronase by mixing 200 µL stock with 3.8 mL egg water; incubate embryos in this solution at room temperature on a nutator at 15–20 rpm until chorions release; wash embryos ≥3 times with ice‑cold egg water to remove enzyme and digested chorions.

steps.title: Pool embryos
steps.instruction: Dispense de‑chorionated embryos into low‑binding 2 mL Eppendorf tubes, ~100 embryos per tube, processing one 100‑embryo batch at a time.

steps.title: Extract intact hearts
steps.instruction: Replace egg water with 1 mL ice‑cold EDM solution; gently aspirate embryos using a 200 µL gel‑loading tip (first 3–5 aspirations with resistance, avoid foaming). For 48 hpf embryos perform 6–8 aspirations with tip cut ~2 mm from the end; for 72 hpf embryos perform 9–12 aspirations with similarly cut tip. Visual inspection under a microscope may guide optimization.

steps.title: Size‑filter tissue
steps.instruction: Load the suspension onto a 70 µm nylon cell strainer, collect flow‑through in a glass Petri dish; then filter this flow‑through through a 40 µm nylon strainer, collecting flow‑through (which contains smaller fragments) in a Petri dish while hearts remain on the strainer; wash the empty Petri dish with ice‑cold EDM solution and reload onto the 40 µm strainer to recover any remaining hearts.

steps.title: Wash retained hearts
steps.instruction: Rinse the tissue retained on the 40 µm strainer with ice‑cold EDM solution and transfer the wash into a clean glass Petri dish.

steps.title: Separate hearts manually
steps.instruction: Under a stereomicroscope, isolate whole hearts from remaining tissue; GFP fluorescence can aid identification in Tg(myl7:EGF) lines, otherwise use bright‑field observation of autonomous contraction.

steps.title: Collect hearts in suspension
steps.instruction: Aspirate isolated hearts with an uncut 200 µL pipette tip into a 2 mL low‑binding Eppendorf tube containing 0.5 mL ice‑cold EDM solution; complete collection for each 100‑embryo batch within one hour, placing earlier batches on ice while processing remaining batches.
